task.title: Check Links Before You Click
task.shortdesc: Check a link or login page before you click it or sign in.

taskbody.prereq: Have a computer that is ready for use.
taskbody.context: Be sure to check any link in an email before clicking on it, especially if the message asks you to sign in or provide personal information.

step.cmd: On a computer, hover over the link to see where it leads to.
Compare the address to the sender and the text in the link.

image.alt: Link address shown in the bottom corner of the browser while hovering over a link.

step.cmd: Before signing into an NC State page, confirm the address starts with shib.ncsu.edu.

taskbody.result: You now know whether an email link is safe to open. If it isn't, don't click on it, and report it instead.
